finding_ko_or_en: 9.08 requires component/interdrug compatibility, non-reclosable/opening-evident/unalterable label packaging, capacity/no damage, FDA/USP incorporation and prescription compounding for combined commercial liquids. 9.08(3) retains 60 days, explicit CII/CIII exclusion and PRN exclusion. 9.04(3) requires clearly printed labels with legibly handwritten/typed emergency failure route; 9.08(6) requires clearly labeled removable cells of sufficient size, each drug name and strength. These do not independently verify protected USP technical content or resolve a policy/regulation conflict.
